description: Use when you need per-rule verdicts on a page. view=rules (default) runs the site's applicable audit rules on 1-5 URLs of that site and returns pass/warn/fail/na per rule (siteId, urls, optional rules); it renders each URL, so expect seconds per URL. view=diff compares one URL's current verdicts with the site's last completed run to show what a fix changed (url, optional siteId and rules). Neither writes an audit run nor flips finding state; after a real fix use verify_fix to close the finding.

rules.description: Optional rule ids to check (default: every rule that applies to the page). Ids that do not apply come back in notApplicable.

siteId.description: Site under this API key; supplies the rule set and the allowed domain.

urls.description: 1–5 http(s) URLs on the site's domain. Duplicates are checked once.

view.description: Which read to run; see the tool description for each view.

name: check_url
title: Run audit rules on URLs, or diff against the last run
